## JobOS Follow-Up Reminder

Reads follow-up dates through JobOS's own candidate-scoped, read-only
`GET /api/candidates/{candidate_id}/follow-ups` endpoint (added
specifically for this workflow -- see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). This
workflow never opens SQLite directly and never writes anything back to
JobOS.

**Two separate API instances exist -- point this workflow at the
right one:**
- Dev API (`127.0.0.1:8420`, jobos_dev.db) -- interactive development
  only, not your real data.
- Production/automation API (`127.0.0.1:8421`, jobos.db) -- started
  with `scripts/run_production_api.py`; this is where your real
  candidate/follow-up data actually lives.

**Before activating:**
1. Open the "JobOS Config" node and set:
   - `jobos_base_url` (default `http://host.docker.internal:8421` --
     never `localhost` from inside the n8n container, it won't reach
     the Mac host).
   - `candidate_id` -- YOUR real candidate id from the production API
     (e.g. `GET http://127.0.0.1:8421/api/candidates/{id}`). Left
     blank by default in this committed file on purpose -- never a
     real candidate id committed to the repo.
2. Pick a daily time on the Schedule Trigger (default: 8:00 AM,
   `GENERIC_TIMEZONE`/`TZ` from docker-compose.yml).
3. This workflow only LOGS due/overdue follow-ups to n8n's own
   execution log by default (visible under this workflow's
   Executions tab). To get an actual notification, add a Slack/Email/
   Telegram node after "Log Due Follow-Ups" -- none is wired in by
   default since no such provider is guaranteed configured (see
   docs/CONFIGURATION.md).

Never submits or changes any application status -- read-only.
